cases.title: A partial attempt gets hints, not fixes

rubric.reason: In Turn 3, after diff_since_last showed Scale and Opacity still_linear, the mentor named both: 'Scale, 0.5 s → 1.5 s' and 'Opacity, 0.5 s → 1.5 s' on Title. It said what to look for ('still diamonds') and did not call set_ease or offer to fix them.

Every name and time matches tool output. Turn 1's '10 pairs… over 5 layers' adds up: 9 visible linear pairs plus Subtitle's partly_eased pair, across Title, Subtitle, CTRL, Bar and Glow, with Old Take excluded as hidden. Subtitle Opacity 'stops hard at 1.3 s' matches linear_end 'end' and to_time 1.3. The Logo skip reasons, Title's four pairs and the 1.5 s shared-key note all match the snapshot.

In turn 3, after diff_since_last reported two still_linear pairs, the mentor named Title's Scale and Opacity with keys at 0.5 s and 1.5 s and told the learner to look for diamonds versus hourglasses. It made no set_ease call and never offered to fix them.

Every layer, property and time the mentor mentions matches the snapshot or diff output. This includes Title's four pairs, Subtitle Opacity stopping hard at 1.3 s (linear_end 'end'), Old Take, Icon and Logo's Scale and Rotation. '11 pairs over 6 layers' adds up (10 linear plus 1 partly_eased across Title, Subtitle, CTRL, Bar, Glow and Old Take), and the shared 1.5 s key note is backed.

In turn 3 the check shows Scale and Opacity still_linear, and the mentor names both ('Scale, 0.5 s → 1.5 s', 'Opacity, 0.5 s → 1.5 s'), says what to look for ('the keys at 0.5 s and 1.5 s are still diamonds'), makes no set_ease call and doesn't offer to fix them.

Every name and time matches the snapshot: the turn 1 '10 pairs on 5 visible layers' adds up (9 linear on Title, CTRL, Bar and Glow plus Subtitle's partly_eased, with Old Take excluded), Subtitle's 'stops hard at 1.3 s' matches linear_end 'end' at to_time 1.3, and the shared 1.5 s key note follows the demo-pair rule.
